messages:
alex: Heads-up — deploybot paused the canary promo: staging CI failing after a helm chart version bump + cache-restore lock. Job 4592 showing timeouts and flaky e2e.

maria: looking now. which test is flaking?

alex: `session_reconnect_spec` is timing out intermittently. Also seeing `cache restore timed out after 120s` in the artifacts service log. snippet:
```
[2026-03-22T18:02:41Z] ERROR cache/restore.go:89 timeout after 120s for key group:uploads/chunk-4592
[2026-03-22T18:03:01Z] e2e/session_reconnect_spec: FAILED (timeout)
```

sam: this started right after the chart bump (chart v1.14.0 -> v1.15.0) — deploybot couldn't find the promoted digest for the new chart because multipart upload retries were happening against the registry. could be a transient registry/storage pressure + cache layer saturation.

jordan: change window at 21:00 UTC. Do we pin chart back to 1.14.0 and rerun, or manual-promote last-green?

alex: prefer a quick pin + rerun to avoid manual-promote if we can. if rerun fails, manual promote last-green and open hotfix.

maria: I can push a staging values pin and trigger a re-run. Will also capture full logs and mark the failing container for infra.

sam: if you pin, please also update release-notes draft to indicate chart-version freeze for the canary. And create a deploybot override flag in case we need to force promote. e.g. `--force-manual-promote` (manual step).

alex: @ci-bot please re-run job 4592 after the pin. @maria tag me when started.

ci-bot: re-run queued: original 4592 -> new run 4600 (triggered by maria).

maria: re-run started, watching e2e. pinging eng-platform if cache restore times out again.

maria: run 4600 completed — all tests green :tada: `session_reconnect_spec` passed, cache restore succeeded this time. I pinned chart to 1.14.0 in staging and updated canary config.

alex: nice. Can we proceed with canary?

deploy-bot: Manual promote requested by alex for release v1.14.0-canary. Safety checks bypassed: chart-pin present. Proceeding with promotion.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete to canary. Health checks ok, no error spikes in first 10m.

alex: great work. Please file a follow-up to investigate the root cause: flaky e2e + cache restore timeouts under concurrent ingest.

sam: I'll add a ticket: INC-2342 with logs + registry multipart retry traces. Also adding a note for release notes: "Canary promoted with chart pin due to transient cache/registry restore timeouts; follow-up investigation in INC-2342."

jordan: adding a card to next sprint for eng-platform to reproduce cache restore saturation and add circuit-breaking.

maria: leaving a short postmortem in #incidents once I upload the logs. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

alex: closing thread — thanks team. :rocket:
